frame.question: What sold the most?
frame.baseline: the average of the 4 weeks before

answer.sentence: Mama Gold Rice 5kg sold most in these 7 days: ₦352,800 from 36 units, the same as usual.
answer.sql:
SELECT p.name AS label,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN l.qty * l.unit_price_ngn - l.discount_ngn ELSE 0 END), 2) AS value_ngn,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) IN (DATE '2026-09-14', DATE '2026-09-15', DATE '2026-09-16', DATE '2026-09-17', DATE '2026-09-18', DATE '2026-09-19', DATE '2026-09-20', DATE '2026-09-21', DATE '2026-09-22', DATE '2026-09-23', DATE '2026-09-24', DATE '2026-09-25', DATE '2026-09-26', DATE '2026-09-27', DATE '2026-09-28', DATE '2026-09-29', DATE '2026-09-30', DATE '2026-10-01', DATE '2026-10-02', DATE '2026-10-03', DATE '2026-10-04', DATE '2026-10-05', DATE '2026-10-06', DATE '2026-10-07', DATE '2026-10-08', DATE '2026-10-09', DATE '2026-10-10', DATE '2026-10-11') THEN l.qty * l.unit_price_ngn - l.discount_ngn ELSE 0 END) / 4, 2) AS usual_ngn,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' THEN l.qty ELSE 0 END) AS units,
       MIN(p.product_id) AS record_id
FROM becuz.sale_lines l JOIN becuz.sales s ON s.sale_id = l.sale_id JOIN becuz.products p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-12' AND DATE '2026-10-18' OR CAST(s.sold_at AS DATE) IN (DATE '2026-09-14', DATE '2026-09-15', DATE '2026-09-16', DATE '2026-09-17', DATE '2026-09-18', DATE '2026-09-19', DATE '2026-09-20', DATE '2026-09-21', DATE '2026-09-22', DATE '2026-09-23', DATE '2026-09-24', DATE '2026-09-25', DATE '2026-09-26', DATE '2026-09-27', DATE '2026-09-28', DATE '2026-09-29', DATE '2026-09-30', DATE '2026-10-01', DATE '2026-10-02', DATE '2026-10-03', DATE '2026-10-04', DATE '2026-10-05', DATE '2026-10-06', DATE '2026-10-07', DATE '2026-10-08', DATE '2026-10-09', DATE '2026-10-10', DATE '2026-10-11')
GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY value_ngn DESC, p.name LIMIT 5
